verdict.rationale: Open-source availability is a fair question for an AI evaluation and observability platform, so the axis applies. The only GitHub item (galileo-gh-1) is a client SDK repo snippet about the @log decorator; it names no license and does not show that the Galileo platform itself is open source. No evidence shows the product's source is available under an open license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
